label: Excel change alerts
text: I'm writing a Tampermonkey script that reads visible Excel cells and notifies me when something changes.

items.text: You're writing a Tampermonkey script that reads the Excel cells you can see on screen
items.quote: Tampermonkey script that reads visible Excel cells

items.text: You want it to tell you when something in those cells changes

concepts.term: userscript on the Excel web page
a watcher that can stop quietly

needs.reason: Only if you use a work Microsoft account, and the file is saved in OneDrive for Business or SharePoint. Then Microsoft's own tools, Office Scripts and Power Automate, can check it on a schedule, even with your browser closed.

ntfy-push-alerts.why: You want to know when a cell changes, and this lets your script tell your phone.
ntfy-push-alerts.how_it_helps: Your script is what spots each change. Your AI can add the part that sends ntfy a short note about it.
ntfy-push-alerts.do_you_need_it: Now if you want to hear about changes away from your computer.
ntfy-push-alerts.skip_if: A computer pop-up is enough, or your alerts already go to a chat app.
ntfy-push-alerts.summary: ntfy: a free alert service with a phone app. Your script sends it a short message, and your phone buzzes.

chrome-devtools-mcp.why: Your AI can look at the Excel page itself to find the cells your script needs.
chrome-devtools-mcp.how_it_helps: Your AI sees exactly where each cell value sits on the Excel page. It can try your cell-reading code there and read any error messages it causes.
chrome-devtools-mcp.do_you_need_it: Now if you're still writing and fixing your script.
chrome-devtools-mcp.skip_if: You'll keep Excel in Edge, or your AI can already read your browser tabs.
chrome-devtools-mcp.summary: A free add-on from Google's Chrome team. It lets your AI open, check and test web pages in Chrome.

healthchecks-io.why: Your script can quietly stop when the tab closes, you're signed out, or Excel changes.
healthchecks-io.how_it_helps: Your script checks in each time it reads the cells, every few minutes. Warnings can come by email, or to your ntfy app.
healthchecks-io.do_you_need_it: Later, once you rely on your script to tell you about changes.
healthchecks-io.skip_if: You check the script yourself every day, and a missed change wouldn't matter.
healthchecks-io.summary: Healthchecks: a free service that emails you when your script stops checking in.
